source_campaign: T001 Котки v4: PROMISE от нулата (бутонът по-високо, без рамки)

banners.prompt:
Create a NEW, finished Facebook/Instagram feed advertising banner for a Bulgarian audience, from scratch.
IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The photo must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames, no inner frame, no blurred strips).
LAYOUT (critical - the final banner is cut to 4:5 from the centre of this tall frame, so the top 15% and the bottom 15% are thrown away): the top 19% of the frame contains ONLY the room background (wall). The headline starts at about 21% from the top. The bottom of the CTA button is at about 78% from the top. Everything below 80% is ONLY the room (table, carpet). Keep about 7% side margins for text.
EXACT VERTICAL LAYOUT (percent of the full frame height, from the top): 0-20% only background. 21-31% the headline (two lines). 32-38% the subheadline (two lines, big). 39-71% the woman with the cat and the book on the table. 72-78% the CTA button. 79-100% only background.
FORMAT: PROMISE - a real person in the desired result plus the book (IMAGE 3 is a winning PROMISE banner style reference - use it only for layout and typography, not its colours or person).
The setting is an ordinary, modest Bulgarian home in a town outside the capital (a typical panel-block or small-house living room: simple furniture, a crocheted doily, a radiator, everyday clutter). Not luxury, not a showroom. The cat is a large, real-looking grey tabby adult cat with yellow-green eyes.
SCENE: a calm, warm evening in the living room. A Bulgarian woman around 50 with short reddish-brown hair and a kind, relaxed smile, in a dusty-rose knitted cardigan, sits on an intact, clean light beige fabric sofa (no scratches at all); the grey tabby cat sleeps curled up peacefully in her lap while she gently strokes it. Clean carpet, a crocheted throw, soft warm lamp light, family photos on a shelf. On the low wooden coffee table in front of the sofa lies the book (IMAGE 2), about 16% of the banner width, next to a cup of tea with a floral pattern. The book must stand out clearly from the table (light cover on dark wood, lit by the lamp).
TEXT ON THE BANNER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Headline at the top on a soft light/cream area, near-black heavy condensed, two lines: "Спокойна, чиста и гальовна котка." - make "гальовна котка." deep orange #E88A00.
2) Subheadline under it, near-black, bold, big, two lines: "Без надраскани мебели, хапане и „изненади“ по килима" (keep the Bulgarian quotation marks „ “ exactly, no full stop at the end).
3) CTA button: "Искам такава котка 👉"
IMAGE 2 is the real book cover of the book "Щастлива котка, щастлив стопанин" (it shows a 3D paperback mockup on white - use only the book itself, not the white background). Reproduce it exactly on the physical book: same design, colours and all cover lettering letter by letter. Do not invent or change any cover text.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation, quotation marks and capital letters. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Use a heavy, clean, condensed sans-serif for headlines (like Oswald Bold / Bebas-style weight but with full Cyrillic).
- Text must be large and clearly legible on a phone at 380px width: headline lines at least ~6% of the banner height, subheadline at least ~4.8% of the banner height (bold, very easy to read on a phone), CTA text ~3.5%. Keep generous side margins (about 6% of the width).
- Strong contrast only: white or near-black text; accent words in warm yellow #F5C518; no grey text on dark backgrounds.
- CTA = rounded pill button in vivid red #E8232A with bold white text, centred near the bottom of the central area. The pointing-hand emoji at the end of the CTA is drawn as a small yellow pointing-right hand icon.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, percentages or website addresses anywhere. No phone screens, no chat or messenger interface, no notification badges.

PHOTO STYLE: realistic, natural-looking photo like a real Bulgarian everyday scene taken with a good phone camera; natural light, real skin and fur texture; not glossy stock, no beauty filter. People have only two hands with five fingers each. The cat looks natural and healthy, no injuries, no blood.

BOOK REALISM (critical - the book must NOT look pasted in like a sticker or a product render): the book is a real, physically present paperback that belongs to the scene. It lies casually at an angle (not facing the camera straight, not standing upright like a display), lit by the SAME light as the scene, soft natural shadow, same depth of field, realistic size (a normal 13x20 cm paperback), slightly worn edges, partly overlapped by something (a cup, a pen, a hand or a cushion edge). The cover design and title must still be recognisable.

CRITICAL POSITION CHECK: the FIRST line of any text must start no higher than 17% of the frame height from the top. The CTA button must end no lower than 87% of the frame height.
NO extra text anywhere in the scene: no posters, signs, wall lettering or written papers besides the book cover.
